title: ST_GeoHash
description: Returns the GeoHash string of a geometry with the given precision.
kernels:
  - returns: string
    args: [geometry, integer]
---

## Description

Encodes the geometry as a base-32 GeoHash string with `precision` characters.
Non-point geometries are encoded using the center of their bounding box.
Returns `NULL` when the geometry's bounding box is not fully contained in the
longitude/latitude range [-180, 180] x [-90, 90]. A non-positive precision
returns an empty string, and precision is capped at 20 characters.

## Examples

```sql
SELECT ST_GeoHash(ST_GeomFromWKT('POINT (21.4234 52.0423)'), 10);
```

```sql
SELECT ST_GeoHash(ST_GeomFromWKT('POLYGON ((0 0, 2 0, 2 2, 0 2, 0 0))'), 8);
```
